vocabulary.meaning_en: an area in a mall with many food stands
vocabulary.example: We had lunch at the food court.

vocabulary.meaning_en: small thin lenses you put on your eyes to see better
vocabulary.example: He wears contact lenses for football.

the way your hair is cut and arranged
a person whose job is cutting hair

vocabulary.example: Do you want a fade haircut?

change the colour of hair or cloth

fine_lines.title: haircut vs trim
fine_lines.explanation_ar: haircut = قصّة شعر قد تغير الشكل. trim = قص قليل للحفاظ على نفس الشكل.
fine_lines.explanation_en: A "haircut" can change your style. A "trim" cuts only a little and keeps the same style.

fine_lines.title: have / get my hair cut
fine_lines.explanation_ar: عندما يقص لك شخص آخر شعرك نقول I have / get my hair cut. أما I cut my hair فتعني أنك قصصته بنفسك.
fine_lines.explanation_en: When someone else does it: "I have/get my hair cut". "I cut my hair" means you did it yourself.

examples.sentence: We would like to have our hair cut.
I cut my hair myself at home.

expressions.phrase: How are things going? / Everything is great.
expressions.meaning_ar: كيف تسير الأمور؟ / كل شيء رائع.
expressions.meaning_en: Asking a friend how life is.
expressions.example: So, how are things going? Everything is fine.

expressions.phrase: You need to get a haircut.
expressions.example: Your hair is long. You need to get a haircut.
I'm going to the market. Why don't we go together?

expressions.phrase: Haven't seen you in a while.
expressions.meaning_en: Greeting someone after a long time.
expressions.example: Hi Sam! Haven't seen you in a while.

expressions.phrase: How would you like your haircut?
expressions.meaning_en: The hairdresser asks what you want.
expressions.example: How would you like your haircut, sir?

expressions.phrase: Let me show you a picture.
expressions.example: I'll explain. Let me show you a picture.
That looks good. I'll go for it then.
Please have a seat. The doctor will see you soon.

expressions.meaning_en: You believe someone will do it well.
expressions.example: Do what you think is best. I totally trust you.

expressions.phrase: I want to try something new.
expressions.example: I always order pasta. Today I want to try something new.

expressions.meaning_en: Saying you found the right thing.
expressions.example: Yes! This is exactly what I want.

grammar.title: have/get something done (causative)
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم have/get + الشيء + التصريف الثالث عندما يقوم شخص آخر بالعمل لنا.
grammar.explanation_en: Use have/get + object + past participle when another person does it for you.
examples: We would like to have our hair cut.
I would like to get my hair dyed.
I get my car washed every week.

grammar.title: Suggestions: Why don't you / How about
grammar.explanation_ar: للاقتراح: Why don't you + فعل? أو How about + اسم؟
grammar.explanation_en: Suggest with "Why don't you + verb?" or "How about + noun?".
examples: Why don't you have a new hairstyle?
